steps.label: the top bar and minimap sit inside the 844x390 screen without overlapping, buttons at least 40 px
steps.expect: (() => { const W = 844, H = 390; const b = {}; for (const part of r.split(' | ')) { const m = part.match(/^([\w-]+) (-?\d+),(-?\d+) (\d+)x(\d+)$/); if (!m) return false; b[m[1]] = { x: +m[2], y: +m[3], w: +m[4], h: +m[5] }; } const ids = Object.keys(b); if (ids.length !== 9) return false; for (const id of ids) { const q = b[id]; if (q.w <= 0 || q.h <= 0 || q.x < 0 || q.y < 0 || q.x + q.w > W || q.y + q.h > H) return false; } for (const id of ['btn-wardrobe', 'btn-map', 'btn-journal', 'btn-pause']) if (b[id].w < 40 || b[id].h < 40) return false; for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < ids.length; j++) { const p = b[ids[i]], q = b[ids[j]]; if (p.x < q.x + q.w - 1 && q.x < p.x + p.w - 1 && p.y < q.y + q.h - 1 && q.y < p.y + p.h - 1) return false; } return true; })()

steps.label: the wardrobe opens with its options and the new-game $150
the Hawaiian shirt is bought for $120 of $150, worn and owned
steps.expect: r === 'after the Hawaiian shirt: wearing hawaii, owned ["shirt:hawaii"], money 30'

steps.label: the $250 antler hat cannot be bought with $30: hat unchanged, money kept, Not enough money
steps.expect: ((m) => !!m && m[1] === '30' && m[2] !== 'antler' && /not enough money/i.test(m[3]))(r.match(/^antler hat with (\d+) left: hat (\S+), toast (.*)$/))

steps.label: with $530 the antler hat is bought ($280 left) and the free beard, hair, skin and gloves are worn
steps.expect: (() => { const m = r.match(/^look (\{.*?\}), owned (\[.*?\]), money (\d+)$/); if (!m) return false; const look = JSON.parse(m[1]), owned = JSON.parse(m[2]); return look.shirt === 'hawaii' && look.hat === 'antler' && look.beard === 'stache' && look.hair === 'ginger' && look.skin === 'brown' && look.gloves === 'wool' && owned.includes('shirt:hawaii') && owned.includes('hat:antler') && +m[3] === 280; })()

steps.label: the sleeves wear the Hawaiian teal, the rod hand wears the cloth, and the save keeps the look and wardrobe
steps.expect: (() => { const m = r.match(/^teal pixels on the sleeve cloth (\d+) of (\d+), rod hand sleeve wears it (\w+); saved look (\{.*?\}), saved wardrobe (\[.*?\])$/); if (!m) return false; const look = JSON.parse(m[4]), owned = JSON.parse(m[5]); return +m[1] > 0.1 * +m[2] && m[3] === 'true' && look.shirt === 'hawaii' && look.hat === 'antler' && look.beard === 'stache' && look.hair === 'ginger' && look.skin === 'brown' && look.gloves === 'wool' && owned.includes('shirt:hawaii') && owned.includes('hat:antler'); })()
